trigger.description: The focusable element that opens the Popover. Pressing it toggles the Popover.

open.description: Whether the Popover is open, when the caller controls it.

defaultOpen.description: Whether the Popover starts open, when it controls itself.

dismissable.description: Whether Escape, an outside press, and the trigger close the Popover. When false, only a button in the close slot closes it, in modal and non-modal mode alike.

placement.description: Where the Popover opens against its trigger or anchorRef. start and end follow the locale direction.

offset.description: The distance in pixels between the Popover and its trigger, along the placement's side.

crossOffset.description: The shift in pixels along the side the Popover is placed against.

shouldFlip.description: Whether the Popover moves to the opposite side when the placed side has no room.

containerPadding.description: The least distance in pixels between the Popover and the edge of the viewport. Must not be negative.

modal.description: Whether the Popover contains focus until it closes. When false, it is non-blocking: it has no focus containment, outside-content exclusion, or scroll locking.

colorScheme.description: Makes the open Popover a scope of this color scheme, whatever the page's. Its surface is that scheme's raised popup surface, not the strong surface an unscoped Popover has, and its text and any Mux UI component inside follow the scheme. Unset leaves the Popover as the page styles it. A scoped Popover also carries the data-muxui-theme and data-muxui-contrast it reads from its trigger's nearest scope, or from the document root, when it opens. While it is open it follows a change to either on the trigger or its ancestors, and it picks up a replaced trigger node on its next render or the next time it opens.

openChange.description: Reports the Popover opening or closing.

MuxUIPlacement.description: How a floating overlay is placed beside its trigger.
